Join Chandan Sir for Lecture 1 of PSIR Paper II Foundation 2027. This live class covers Political Theory, beginning with its meaning and various approaches. Build a clear understanding of the foundational concepts required for PSIR Optional preparation and follow the lecture as part of your structured UPSC preparation.
